title: Copilot Studio: agent responses in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat match Copilot Chat's own
summary: The roadmap facts, agent-blocking controls and existing billing rules are supported. The updated channel documentation still supports the cited prerequisites and citation guidance. One minor correction is needed: the unknown licensing model understates the existing product entitlement and consumption rules already described in the briefing.

claims.claim: An admin can block an agent in Microsoft 365 admin center through Agents > All agents > agent > Block > Block agent > Save.
claims.quote: Select **Agents** > **All agents**. ... select an agent from the list of agents. ... select **Block** or **Unblock**. ... select either **Block agent** or **Unblock agent**, and then select **Save**.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.where: controls[1].governs; controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Blocking is a general control over the whole selected agent's organizational availability, not just its response presentation.
claims.quote: **Block and unblock** | Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.

claims.claim: Blocking a Copilot Studio agent affects its availability and functionality in Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: Blocking or unblocking an agent that you created by using Microsoft Copilot Agent Builder and Microsoft Copilot Studio affects its availability and functionality in Microsoft Copilot.

claims.claim: Blocking a Copilot Studio agent also affects its availability and functionality in other host products such as Outlook and Teams.
claims.quote: It also affects availability and functionality in other host products, such as Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Teams, or other Microsoft 365 applications.

claims.claim: The Graph block call is beta and subject to change.
claims.quote: APIs under the `/beta` version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: Access to the Package Management API used for the block call requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.
claims.quote: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: The Graph block call's delegated permission is CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All.
claims.quote: Delegated (work or school account) | CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All | Not available.
